```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mind-ar@1.2.2/dist/mindar-face.prod.js"></script>
<script src="https://aframe.io/releases/1.4.2/aframe.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mind-ar@1.2.2/dist/mindar-face-aframe.prod.js"></script>

<style>
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

.ar-page {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0A0A0F 0%, #1a0e2e 40%, #2D1B4E 100%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    color: #F5E6E0;
    padding: 2rem 1rem 3rem;
}

.ar-header {
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 560px;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.ar-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #C9A87C;
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.3);
    padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 50px;
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}

.ar-header h1 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 5vw, 2.8rem);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C9A87C, #F5E6E0, #C9A87C);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-size: 200% auto;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.ar-header p {
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.55);
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

/* --- Scene container --- */
.ar-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 560px;
    height: 70vh;
    min-height: 400px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,124,0.2);
    background: #0A0A0F;
}

/* A-Frame scene fills entire container — always visible so canvas sizes correctly */
#ar-scene {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
}

/* Overlay sits on top via z-index */
#ar-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 20;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1.2rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(10,10,15,0.97), rgba(45,27,78,0.97));
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
}

#ar-overlay.hidden {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.ar-overlay-icon { font-size: 3rem; }

#ar-overlay h2 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    color: #F5E6E0;
}

#ar-overlay p {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.5);
    max-width: 280px;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

/* --- Buttons --- */
.ar-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 560px;
}

.ar-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.85rem 1.8rem;
    border-radius: 50px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    border: none;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.ar-btn-start {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7A1B3D, #9B2B55);
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(122,27,61,0.4);
}
.ar-btn-start:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(122,27,61,0.55);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9B2B55, #B53365);
}

.ar-btn-capture {
    background: rgba(201,168,124,0.12);
    color: #C9A87C;
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.4);
}
.ar-btn-capture:hover {
    background: rgba(201,168,124,0.22);
    border-color: #C9A87C;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.ar-btn-stop {
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.4);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.ar-btn-stop:hover { color: #F5E6E0; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

.ar-status {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(201,168,124,0.45);
    margin-top: 0.6rem;
    min-height: 1em;
}

.ar-tips {
    max-width: 560px;
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: 0.8rem;
}
.ar-tip {
    background: rgba(45,27,78,0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,124,0.07);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    color: rgba(245,230,224,0.45);
    line-height: 1.5;
}
.ar-tip strong {
    display: block;
    color: rgba(201,168,124,0.7);
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.ar-back {
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
}
.ar-back a {
    color: rgba(201,168,124,0.4);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
}
.ar-back a:hover { color: #C9A87C; }

@keyframes ar-flash {
    0% { opacity: 0; }
    15% { opacity: 0.8; }
    100% { opacity: 0; }
}
.ar-flash-el {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: white;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 25;
    animation: ar-flash 0.45s ease-out forwards;
    border-radius: 20px;
}

#snap-canvas { display: none; }
</style>

<div class="ar-page">

  <div class="ar-header">
    <span class="ar-badge">✦ Réalité Augmentée</span>
    <h1>Votre moment AT</h1>
    <p>Activez la caméra, posez avec le livre, capturez le souvenir.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-container" id="ar-container">

    <!-- A-Scene is ALWAYS in the DOM so AFrame can size its canvas -->
    <a-scene id="ar-scene"
      mindar-face="autoStart: false; uiLoading: no; uiError: no; uiScanning: no;"
      embedded
      vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
      device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">

      <a-assets>
        <img id="at-cover-tex"
          src="../images/couvertures/AT_couverture.PNG"
          crossorigin="anonymous" />
      </a-assets>

      <a-camera active="false" position="0 0 0"></a-camera>

      <!-- Book cover anchored to left cheek landmark, offset outward -->
      <a-entity mindar-face-target="anchorIndex: 127">
        <!-- Glow behind cover -->
        <a-plane
          color="#7A1B3D"
          position="0 0 -0.005"
          width="0.26" height="0.38"
          material="opacity: 0.3; transparent: true; shader: flat;">
        </a-plane>
        <!-- Book cover -->
        <a-plane
          src="#at-cover-tex"
          position="0 0 0"
          width="0.23" height="0.35"
          material="alphaTest: 0.05; transparent: false;">
        </a-plane>
      </a-entity>

    </a-scene>

    <!-- Overlay on top — hides behind the scene once dismissed -->
    <div id="ar-overlay">
      <div class="ar-overlay-icon">📸</div>
      <h2>Filtre AT The Beginning</h2>
      <p>Votre caméra va s'activer. Assurez-vous d'être dans un endroit bien éclairé.</p>
      <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-start" id="start-btn">✨ Activer la caméra</button>
    </div>

    <canvas id="snap-canvas"></canvas>
  </div>

  <!-- Controls below the scene -->
  <div class="ar-controls" id="ar-controls" style="display:none;">
    <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-capture" onclick="captureAR()">📷 Capturer</button>
    <button class="ar-btn ar-btn-stop" onclick="stopAR()">✕ Arrêter</button>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-status" id="ar-status"></div>

  <div class="ar-tips">
    <div class="ar-tip">
      <strong>📱 Mobile</strong>
      Portrait, visage bien éclairé, caméra frontale.
    </div>
    <div class="ar-tip">
      <strong>💻 Desktop</strong>
      Face à la webcam, à 50–70 cm.
    </div>
    <div class="ar-tip">
      <strong>📸 Capture</strong>
      Cliquez "Capturer" pour télécharger votre photo.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ar-back">
    <a href="./at_the_beginning.html">← Retour à AT The Beginning</a>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var sceneEl = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('ar-overlay');
  var controls = document.getElementById('ar-controls');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('ar-status');
  var startBtn = document.getElementById('start-btn');

  function setStatus(msg) { statusEl.textContent = msg; }

  // Start AR when scene is loaded + button clicked
  startBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    startBtn.disabled = true;
    startBtn.textContent = '…Chargement';
    setStatus('Initialisation de la caméra…');

    function doStart() {
      var sys = sceneEl.systems && sceneEl.systems['mindar-face-system'];
      if (sys) {
        sys.start().then(function () {
          overlay.classList.add('hidden');
          controls.style.display = 'flex';
          setStatus('✦ Placez votre visage dans le cadre');
        }).catch(function (err) {
          setStatus('⚠ Erreur : ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'vérifiez les autorisations caméra.'));
          startBtn.disabled = false;
          startBtn.textContent = '✨ Activer la caméra';
          console.error('MindAR start error:', err);
        });
      } else {
        // Retry once after short delay if system not ready
        setTimeout(doStart, 300);
      }
    }

    if (sceneEl.hasLoaded) {
      doStart();
    } else {
      sceneEl.addEventListener('loaded', doStart, { once: true });
    }
  });

  window.stopAR = function () {
    var sys = sceneEl.systems && sceneEl.systems['mindar-face-system'];
    if (sys) sys.stop();
    overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    controls.style.display = 'none';
    setStatus('');
    startBtn.disabled = false;
    startBtn.textContent = '✨ Activer la caméra';
  };

  window.captureAR = function () {
    // Flash
    var container = document.getElementById('ar-container');
    var flash = document.createElement('div');
    flash.className = 'ar-flash-el';
    container.appendChild(flash);
    setTimeout(function () { if (flash.parentNode) flash.parentNode.removeChild(flash); }, 500);

    // Get AFrame renderer canvas
    var aCanvas = sceneEl.canvas;
    if (!aCanvas) { setStatus('⚠ Impossible de capturer.'); return; }

    // Get the video element MindAR creates
    var video = document.querySelector('video');
    var snap = document.getElementById('snap-canvas');
    snap.width = aCanvas.width;
    snap.height = aCanvas.height;
    var ctx = snap.getContext('2d');

    // Draw video (mirrored) then AR overlay
    if (video && video.readyState >= 2) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(snap.width, 0);
      ctx.scale(-1, 1);
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, snap.width, snap.height);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.drawImage(aCanvas, 0, 0, snap.width, snap.height);

    snap.toBlob(function (blob) {
      if (!blob) { setStatus('⚠ Capture échouée.'); return; }
      var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = 'AT-The-Beginning-filtre.png';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      setStatus('✦ Photo enregistrée !');
      setTimeout(function () { setStatus('✦ Placez votre visage dans le cadre'); }, 3000);
    }, 'image/png');
  };
})();
</script>
```
